endpoints.description: 📦 Create a Trade Offer on Steam
details: Initiates a new trade offer for a specific user.
Requires a valid `steamloginsecure`, retrievable from Steam cookies.
Supports sending items (`myitemassetids`) and requesting items (`partneritemassetids`).
Trade link and partner Steam ID ensure secure targeting.
Includes a custom message option for the trade.
usage_notes: Provide required parameters in a JSON payload.
Use optional parameters like `game` for game-specific trade offers.
Set `production=1` for production environments.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your API key for authentication. Retrieve it from your Dashboard (top-right corner).

parameters.name: production
parameters.description: If you run in production, please set this to 1. Default is 0. This is in future required, and if not set, you will get a warning.

request_body.description: JSON payload containing the required parameters for initiating a new trade offer

properties.name: steamloginsecure
properties.description: Cookie value for Steam authentication.

properties.name: partneritemassetids
properties.description: Comma-separated list of asset IDs for items to request from partner.

properties.name: myitemassetids
properties.description: Comma-separated list of asset IDs for items to send to partner.

properties.name: tradelink
properties.description: Trade link of the user. Either tradelink or partnersteamid must be provided.

properties.name: partnersteamid
properties.description: Steam ID of the trade partner. Either tradelink or partnersteamid must be provided.

properties.name: message
properties.description: Optional message for the trade offer.

properties.name: game
properties.description: Game for which the trade offer is being created.

responses.description: Invalid asset ID provided or too many pending trade offers.
Trade offer creation failed - too many cancellations.
Unauthorized access due to invalid/expired steamloginsecure.
Validation error for the request body.

endpoints.description: 🔒 Accept a Trade Offer on Steam
details: Accepts a trade offer on Steam.
Requires Steam credentials and trade details.
Allows accepting trade offers programmatically.
Requires `2FA` if items are involved in the trade.
usage_notes: Provide required parameters (`steamloginsecure`, `tradeofferid`, and `partnersteamid`) in the request body.
Authenticate using your API key for access.
Set `production=1` for production environments.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your API key for authentication. Retrieve it from your Dashboard (top-right corner).

parameters.name: production
parameters.description: If you run in production, please set this to 1. Default is 0. This is in future required, and if not set, you will get a warning.

request_body.description: JSON payload containing the required parameters for accepting a trade offer

properties.name: steamloginsecure
properties.description: Cookie value from steamcommunity.com for authentication.

properties.name: tradeofferid
properties.description: The ID of the trade offer to accept.

properties.name: partnersteamid
properties.description: The Steam ID of the trade partner.

responses.description: Unauthorized access. Invalid or expired steamloginsecure.
Unauthorized access due to invalid or expired steamloginsecure.
Validation error for the request body.

details: Retrieves the trade history of a user.
Provides a secure and efficient way to access all trades associated with the user.
Perfect for verifying trade success and tracking the user's trade activity.
Uses webhooks to deliver trade history data.
usage_notes: Send the `steamloginsecure` cookie value from steamcommunity.com in the request body.
Provide a webhook URL where trade history updates will be sent.
Set `production=1` for production environments.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your API key for authentication. Retrieve it from your Dashboard (top-right corner).

parameters.name: production
parameters.description: If you run in production, please set this to 1. Default is 0. This is in future required, and if not set, you will get a warning.

request_body.description: JSON payload containing the required parameters for retrieving trade history

properties.name: steamloginsecure
properties.description: Raw steamLoginSecure token from the cookie of steamcommunity.com. Use the raw steamLoginSecure from the cookie. Can also be retrieved automatically using our Extension.

properties.name: webhook
properties.description: The URL where the trade history data is sent to.

details: Retrieve all incoming trade offers that are pending for acceptance.
This endpoint fetches all trade offers waiting for acceptance by the user.
Real-time Data: Fetch trade offers in real-time using the `steamloginsecure` token, ensuring you get up-to-date information directly from Steam.
Rate Limiting: Be mindful of the rate limits on the `steamloginsecure` token. If too many requests are made at once, delays may occur.
usage_notes: Provide the `steamloginsecure` token (or use our Extension) to retrieve all pending trade offers for the authenticated user.
Optionally, include `forcesteamids` to get Steam IDs for all trade offers (may increase response time).

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your API key for authentication. Retrieve it from your Dashboard (top-right corner).

request_body.description: JSON payload containing the required parameters for fetching pending trade offers

properties.name: steamloginsecure
properties.description: Raw steamLoginSecure token from the steamcommunity.com cookie. You can also use our Extension for automatic token retrieval.

properties.name: forcesteamids
properties.description: If enabled, forces the return of Steam IDs for each trade offer. This may result in slower response times.

responses.description: Success - Pending trade offers successfully retrieved.
Unauthorized access due to missing or invalid steamloginsecure token.
Missing required parameters or rate limit exceeded
Invalid JSON format in the request.
